idea: Safety #1 – hot things (LIVING ROOM): soft white steam puffs up from Baby Ava's pink mug of warm milk right as she reaches for it ('Oh! Look, steam! It's hot, hot, hot!'); she pulls her hands back and puts them on her tummy, shaking her head ('Hot, hot! Don't touch! Hands on your tummy!' – copy-me); Mommy Lily kneels beside her and holds up one finger ('Mommy, is it hot? Wait, wait, wait!'); Ava blows on the milk ('Blow with me! Whoo, whoo, whoo!' – copy-me) until the steam is gone; she asks the viewer 'Is it hot? Do we touch? Hmm?' (pause) – 'No, no! We wait and blow!'; lesson 'Hot? Don't touch! Ask a grown-up!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now no steam, hand on her cooled mug, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Hot things: don't touch – hands back, ask a grown-up and wait, blow until it is cool.
calendar: Wednesday slot 2 – Safety (first safety episode: hot things / don't touch).

variety.outfit: Ava HOME (yellow dress, matches the sheet); Mommy Lily HOME

characters: Ava (HOME): BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing a soft yellow dress with ruffle sleeves and a small pink flower, and pink baby shoes with bows.

Mommy Lily (HOME, shot 3): MOMMY: a kind young mother in 3D Pixar style, blonde hair in a messy high bun with loose curly strands around her face, big bright blue eyes, rosy cheeks, gentle sweet smile. wearing a loose soft coral oversized short-sleeve t-shirt, light blue wide-leg loose jeans, white sneakers and small gold hoop earrings.

supporting_objects.mug: AVA'S MUG: a small round pink mug with a little white flower on it, full of warm milk. With soft white curly cartoon steam in shots 1-4 (big → smaller), none in shot 5.

setting: LIVING ROOM: a bright cozy living room with cream walls, a big soft mint-green sofa with yellow and pink cushions and a cream knitted blanket, a round light-wood coffee table, a big round rainbow rug, a large window with white curtains on the RIGHT side looking at the garden, three framed family photos on the wall above the sofa (a big photo of the whole family in the middle, Baby Jimmy alone on the left, Baby Ava alone on the right), green plants, a low white bookshelf with picture books and a wicker toy basket.

learning.goal: When something is hot (you see steam), don't touch it: hands back, ask a grown-up and wait, blow until it is cool.
learning.shown_how: Big soft steam from Ava's pink mug right beside her face (hook); hands on tummy, head shake no-no (step 1); Mommy's 'wait' finger (step 2); Ava blows, steam fades (step 3); loop with no steam.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:20 'Is it hot? Do we touch? Hmm?' (question boing) + 0:20-0:22 humming pause → 0:22 'No, no! We wait and blow! Yay!' + cheer
learning.copy_me: 0:03-0:07 hands on your tummy; 0:11-0:15 'Blow with me! Whoo, whoo, whoo!'
learning.fact_check: Steam = hot; correct safe behavior (don't touch, ask a grown-up, wait, blow); exactly ONE mug; no text/letters/numbers anywhere (framed family photos are pictures only).
learning.modeling: Ava starts to reach but stops herself in the hook (gentle near-mistake corrected at once); she never touches the mug while it steams; she only holds it in the loop when the steam is gone; Mommy is nearby.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, cozy calm living room, nothing scary (no burn, no pain), one baby, big face.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: steam puffs up – 'Oh! Look, steam!'
say-it-with-me chorus: Hot, hot! Don't touch!
interactive pause: Is it hot? Do we touch?
